name: ground-motion-analysis
title: 地震动分析
description: Analyze accelerograms, intensity measures, and response spectra with explicit units and processing provenance. Use for seismic waveform analysis, not GMM fitting.

name: gmm-residual-analysis
title: GMM 残差分析
description: Compare observed ground motion with published GMM predictions and diagnose residual patterns. Use for model evaluation, not estimating random effects.

name: mixed-effects-reml
title: 混合效应 REML
description: Fit and diagnose linear mixed models using REML with crossed event and station effects. Use for variance estimation and uncertainty, not choosing fixed effects by REML likelihood.

name: event-path-site-decomposition
title: 震源—路径—场地分解
description: Decompose seismic residuals into event, path and site contributions with identifiability checks. Use when physical attribution beyond a residual fit is requested.

name: random-vibration-simulation
title: 随机振动模拟
description: Simulate stochastic earthquake motion or apply random vibration theory with explicit source, path, site and duration assumptions. Use for stochastic simulations, not deterministic rupture solvers.

name: scenario-earthquake
title: 情景地震
description: Construct reproducible earthquake scenarios and conditional ground-motion estimates. Use for scenario planning, not probabilistic hazard or earthquake prediction.

name: earthquake-rapid-analysis
title: 地震快速研判
description: Prepare a source-timestamped rapid earthquake assessment from preliminary event reports and observations. Use after a reported event; do not issue predictions or unverified casualties.

name: evidence-chain
title: 证据链
description: Trace manuscript claims to inspectable observations, analyses and sources. Use for claim support audits and evidence planning.

name: figure-audit
title: 图件审计
description: Audit scientific figures against source data, uncertainty and manuscript claims. Use for figure correctness and evidence presentation, not cosmetic redesign alone.

name: paper-storyline
title: 论文主线
description: Build an evidence-grounded manuscript argument and figure sequence from author-provided results. Use for research narrative structure, not journal-specific stylistic imitation.

name: reviewer-audit
title: 审稿视角审计
description: Review scientific manuscripts for validity, contribution and actionable major/minor concerns using provided evidence. Use for mock peer review, not submission decisions or author rebuttals.

name: reproducibility-audit
title: 可复现性审计
description: Audit whether scientific outputs can be traced and rerun from inputs, code and environments. Use for provenance, rerun and delivery checks.

name: journal-bridge
title: 期刊技能桥接
description: Connect research tasks to separately installed journal skills and current author instructions. Use for Cell, Nature, Science or other journal constraints without bundling third-party text.

name: researchflow-router
title: 科研任务路由
description: Route multi-step earthquake research and manuscript tasks to relevant ResearchFlow skills with dependency-aware parallel suggestions. Use for combined workflows, not every single-task request.
